title: Zephyrine and the Hollow
author: Petra Thackeray
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
